description: This file defines the SecurityController class in a Spring Boot application, managing user profile retrieval and updates with security checks.

classes.name: SecurityController
classes.description: Controller class for handling user profile viewing and editing functionalities, secured with role-based access control.

methods.name: getUserProfile
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the current authenticated user's profile information.

methods.name: getForEdit
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve user data for editing, ensuring the user matches the profile being edited.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update user profile details after authentication verification.

methods.name: patchUser
methods.description: Handles POST requests for partial updates (patch) on user data, verifying authentication.
